properties.notes: Previously the site of a water treatment works but the buildings and infrastructure has been cleared. Planning permission is in place for redevelopment of the site for 8 units (17/01360/REM). This is yet to commence but completion is anticipated in the next 5 years. Site mainly comprises of brownfield in nature and, although there is some greenfield land, the yield indicated recognises focus on brownfield element (1.60ha). For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 3651) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 3.05ha.A number of previous applications relate to site and this latest consent supersedes initial outline and also a reserved matters approvals (14/02721/OUT, 15/03842/REM).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
